standard.notes: Fire Officer I focuses on company-level leadership: supervision, emergency service delivery, admin, human resources, and community risk basics. Promotional processes are department-specific.

title: Fire Officer I
description: Complete company officer pathway: leadership, tactics, crew management, administrative duties, and emergency service delivery at the company level.
audience: Engineers / senior firefighters preparing for lieutenant or captain
Candidates for state or IFSAC/Pro Board Fire Officer I

estimatedRange.typicalHours: 40–80+ instructional hours plus documented leadership experience

prerequisites.title: Firefighter II or equivalent operational foundation
prerequisites.detail: Most systems expect solid structural firefighter competence before company officer work.

prerequisites.title: Operational experience / time-in-grade
prerequisites.detail: Departments usually require minimum years of service and/or engine/truck experience before promotional eligibility.

prerequisites.title: Fire Instructor I (recommended companion)
prerequisites.detail: Often expected for company officers who deliver drills.

corequisitesAndCommonCompanions.title: ICS 300
corequisitesAndCommonCompanions.notes: Supports expanding incident management and multi-unit supervision.

knowledgeDomains.title: Human resource management at company level

jprSkillGroups.title: Supervise and develop company members
skills: Provide feedback and document performance issues appropriately
Lead daily readiness and training activities

jprSkillGroups.title: Administrative reports and policy application
skills: Apply department policies to routine situations

jprSkillGroups.title: Pre-incident planning / company inspection support
skills: Identify obvious hazards during company-level surveys

jprSkillGroups.title: Direct company emergency operations
skills: Direct company members on common incident types

jprSkillGroups.title: Post-incident review and improvement
skills: Participate in or lead company-level after-action discussion

trainingSequence.title: Confirm promotional / course eligibility
actions: Enroll in approved Fire Officer I program if pursuing formal cert

trainingSequence.title: Leadership, HR, and admin classroom block
Practical leadership and scenario work
actions: Tabletop and evolutions as company leader

trainingSequence.title: Certification testing and promotional prep
actions: Complete FO I written/practical requirements if applicable
File certificate and portfolio evidence in Career Record

assessment.practical: Scenario leadership, reports, and company-level task demonstrations
assessment.written: Exam on FO I knowledge areas and local policy where required
assessment.passingCriteria: State certifying entity and/or department promotional standards
documentationNeeded: FO I certificate / seals if issued

stateOverlayGuidance.howToUse: Record whether FO I is state-certified, required for lieutenant/captain, and any local assessment-center expectations.
alwaysVerifyWith: IFSAC / Pro Board entity if seals are issued

sources.title: NFPA 1021 Fire Officer professional qualifications
sources.note: Do not paste copyrighted JPR text verbatim.

disclaimer: Structured training roadmap for personal professional development. Promotional authority remains with the hiring department and civil service rules.
